title: Chlamydia trachomatis PCR
author: Ana Ximena Kiguen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zeef3be
materials: I n a thermocycler , incubate as follows for ompA gene: 95 °C 00:04:00 49 amplification cycles as follows: 95 °C 00:01:00 55 °C 00:01:00 72 °C 00:01:30 Incubate as follows for Cryptic Plasmid: 95 °C 00:04:00 35 amplification cycles as follows: 95 °C 00:01:00 55 °C 00:01:00 72 °C 00:01:30 followed by a final elongation 72 °C 00:04:00

steps.title: Prepare pre‑amplification master mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine 12.5 µL Pre‑Amplification Mix, 6.5 µL Mint Master Mix, 0.5 µL ultrapure water, and the appropriate primers (NRO/NLO for the ompA gene and CTP1/CTP2 for the cryptic plasmid).

steps.title: Add extracted DNA template
steps.instruction: Add 5 µL extracted DNA to the master mix and mix gently.

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 % agarose gel for visualization
steps.instruction: Dissolve 0.75 g agarose in 50 mL water to make a 1.5 % gel, add 3 µL Eco Gel (loading dye), cast the gel, load PCR products, run electrophoresis, and visualize the bands.
